title: The canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB pathways and their crosstalk: A comparative study based on Petri nets.
authors: Trares, Kira; Ackermann, Jorg; Koch, Ina
one_liner_zh: 该文用Petri网建模NF-kappaB信号通路，虽涉及转录因子激活，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，仅属系统生物学通路模拟，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: NF-kappaB is a protein complex that occurs in almost all animal cell types. It regulates the cellular immune responses to stimuli in the nucleus. Dysregulation of NF-kappaB can cause severe diseases like chronic inflammation, autoimmune diseases or cancer. We modeled the two major pathways leading from the external cellular stimulation of the CD40 receptor to the nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB dimers, the canonical and non-canonical pathway. Based on literature data, we developed two Petri net models describing these pathways. In a third Petri net, we combined the two models, introducing crosstalk specific in CD40L-stimulated B cells. In terms of structural properties, we checked the Petri nets for their consistency and correctness. To explore differences and similarities, we compared structural properties and the simulation behavior of the models. The non-canonical NF-kappaB pathway exhibited a more diverse regulation than the canonical pathway. Applying in silico knockout analyses, we were able to quantify the relevance of individual biochemical processes. We predicted interrelationships, e.g., between the synthesis of the protein NF-kappaB-inducing kinase and the processing of the precursor protein p100. The activation of the transcription factors, p50-RelA and p52-RelB, was affected by most of the knockouts. The results of the in silico knockout were in accordance with experimental studies. The Petri net models provide a basis for further analyses and could be extended to include gene expression, additional pathways, molecular processes, and kinetic data.
abstract_zh: NF-kappaB是一种几乎存在于所有动物细胞类型中的蛋白质复合物。它在细胞核中调节细胞对刺激的免疫反应。NF-kappaB的失调可导致严重疾病，如慢性炎症、自身免疫性疾病或癌症。我们模拟了从CD40受体的外部细胞刺激到NF-kappaB二聚体核转位的两条主要通路，即经典通路和非经典通路。基于文献数据，我们开发了两个描述这些通路的Petri网模型。在第三个Petri网中，我们结合了这两个模型，引入了CD40L刺激的B细胞中特有的串扰。在结构性质方面，我们检查了Petri网的一致性和正确性。为了探索差异和相似性，我们比较了模型的结构性质和模拟行为。非经典NF-kappaB通路表现出比经典通路更多样化的调控。通过应用计算机模拟敲除分析，我们能够量化单个生化过程的相关性。我们预测了相互关系，例如，蛋白质NF-kappaB诱导激酶的合成与前体蛋白p100的加工之间的关系。转录因子p50-RelA和p52-RelB的激活受到大多数敲除的影响。计算机模拟敲除的结果与实验研究一致。Petri网模型为进一步分析提供了基础，并可扩展以包括基因表达、额外通路、分子过程和动力学数据。
